title: Prioritize complete European resource banks
platforms: European ROM; retained Wine evidence and protected static census
changes: Prioritize complete source-backed resource banks and classify bounded direct references to the known relative-directory resolver before selecting further extraction work.
validation: Protected unit 6lzwu92a authenticates the EUR ROM and resolver pins, finding six bounded Thumb BL patterns with nearby literals only for the two already managed 103-entry directories.
limitations: Nearby literals are not proven arguments and a linear pattern scan does not prove absence of indirect calls, other readers, ARM code or banks outside its interval. Other pointer groups and runtime/platform work remain open; no performance comparison was made.
